description_html: Overview of the Role:      Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.       As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.       Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.     The  Low Latency Network Solutions Architect  is a seasoned professional role, who applies in-depth IT knowledge and experience towards gathering and analyzing business and application requirements in support of Citi's global financial services, Electronic Trading, Markets, and Quantitative Investment platforms.   With the primary goal to design strategic target state low-latency network architectures, using defined standards to maximize throughput, minimize deterministic packet latency and jitter, and ensure maximum capacity while driving IT operational efficiency and cost optimization. They will possess in-depth experience in high-performance networking, exchange colocation ecosystems, ultra-low latency switching, multicast market data distribution, and hardware acceleration platforms, providing robust network services across private cloud data centers, colocation facilities, and hybrid cloud environments, integrating orchestration and automation to rapidly deliver infrastructure solutions.    Key Responsibilities:       Trusted Advisor:  Supporting CTI businesses and Markets Technology as a trusted advisor for all low-latency network solution and engineering tasks.     Stakeholder Collaboration:  Engage in routine discussions with key stakeholders (Network Engineering, Systems Administrators, Core Infrastructure Build, Application Owners, Business Sponsors) regarding application performance and connectivity requirements.     Enterprise Architecture Alignment:  Collaborate with Application Architects, Electronic Trading Developers, DevOps, Market Data, and Telecommunications teams to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and low-latency best practices.     Design Artifacts & Documentation:  Ability to take all elements of a solution design and capture them in both narrative form and detailed architectural diagram form (Visio) in such a way that both technical and business stakeholders can understand.     Resiliency & Performance Sizing:  Must grasp the technical aspects of an application's RTO / RPO, failover mechanisms, and zero-packet-drop high availability when designing an infrastructure solution.     Technology & Hardware Evaluation:  Evaluate emerging low-latency networking technologies, Layer 1 switching fabrics, FPGA/SmartNIC acceleration, kernel bypass technologies, and optical transport services to continuously improve network architecture.     Subject Matter Expert (SME):  Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for all low-latency network technologies, cut-through switching architectures, Multicast routing (PIM-SM, PIM-SSM, IGMP), Precision Time Protocol (PTP IEEE 1588v2), and Direct Market Access (DMA) integration patterns.     Security & Governance:  Define and enforce network security, micro-segmentation, low-latency encryption (MACsec), audit compliance, and disaster recovery strategies across trading and colocation fabrics.     Mentorship:  Mentor and guide junior architects and network engineers in best practices surrounding network automation, latency monitoring, and infrastructure governance.     Cloud Transformation:  Support the organization's cloud and hybrid connectivity initiatives with a strong understanding of low-latency cloud interconnection services (e.g., AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, GCP Dedicated Interconnect).     Performance Optimization:  Drive innovation, latency reduction, micro-burst mitigation, and telemetry optimization initiatives across all global trading network platforms.          Qualifications:        Capacity & Infrastructure Sizing:  Deep understanding of how electronic trading and financial application requirements determine infrastructure type, switch buffer architecture, link oversubscription ratios, and High Availability / Disaster Recovery capabilities.     Engineering Background:  Prior experience as a Senior Network Engineer, Network Architect, or Systems Infrastructure Engineer in a high-volume financial services, electronic trading, or Tier-1 service provider environment. Experience in root-cause analysis (RCA) techniques in complex data center and colocation environments.     Communication Skills:  Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts across teams.     Project Leadership:  Ability to develop strong working relationships, manage multiple projects with competing priorities, and lead architectural initiatives.     Continuous Learning:  Team player with willingness to learn the latest technologies, while taking initiative to master new tasks and industry trends quickly.     Hardware Expertise:  Demonstrated expertise in low-latency switching and routing platforms (e.g., Arista 7130 / MetaWatch / 7050 / 7060, Cisco Nexus 3500 / 9000 series, ExaNIC, SmartNICs, and FPGA-accelerated network interface cards) with practical experience in high-volume, mission-critical environments.     Protocol Mastery:  Hands-on experience designing Layer 2/3 network fabrics, BGP, OSPF, Multicast routing (PIM-SM, PIM-SSM, IGMPv2/v3), cut-through switching, and VXLAN/EVPN.     Time Synchronization & Telemetry:  Strong knowledge of high-precision time synchronization (PTP IEEE 1588v2, SyncE, GPS grandmaster clocks) and network packet capture analytics platforms (e.g., Corvil, Endace, cPacket, Wireshark).     Host & Kernel Optimization:  Solid understanding of host-level networking optimizations, kernel bypass frameworks (e.g., Solarflare Onload / ef_vi, DPDK), socket buffer tuning, and CPU core pinning.     DevOps & Automation:  Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and network automation frameworks (e.g., Python, Ansible, Terraform).      Critical Competencies & Preferred Certifications:      Effective communication and presentation skills to guide architectural review boards, provide technical direction, and conduct executive presentations with business sponsors      Certification Domain    Preferred Industry Certification    Cisco Systems   Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) / CCDE (Data Center or Enterprise Infrastructure)   Arista Networks   Arista Certified Engineering Expert (ACE-A / ACE-P / ACE-L3)   Public Cloud Networking   AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty / Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer   Enterprise Architecture   TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture framework certification    Education:      Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or 6+ years of relevant experience working with enterprise mission-critical, low-latency trading infrastructure systems.                ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Architecture            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $125 760,00 - $188 640,00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: Senior Lead Technical Program Manager (Cleared)
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Program & Project Management    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship with the ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role.  ​    PLEASE NOTE: Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation as well as your having and maintaining the specific level of U.S. government background investigation and clearance required (active TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph) for this role.      Location: Herndon, VA. This is an onsite role 5 days per week. This is NOT a remote position.       The Experience      Salesforce National Security (SNS) builds and operates secure environments for government customers. As a Senior Technical Program Manager for GovCloud, you will own technical program management across new technical builds and other prioritized engineering initiatives.    You will work closely with product, engineering, infrastructure, security, operations, and business leaders to turn strategic objectives into executable plans. You will manage critical dependencies and drive decisions that balance delivery commitments, technical constraints, and customer needs.    You will own program strategy and execution for new GovCloud environment builds and related product and engineering initiatives, partnering across Salesforce to deliver capabilities for current and future government customers      What You’ll Actually Be Doing     Establish program structures and build cross-functional consensus, aligning teams around GovCloud stakeholder priorities, strategic vision, and business objectives.    Use technical, analytical, and Agile methods to guide and support software engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.    Lead program Steering Committee forums with key partners to guide critical decisions, clear blockers, and resolve operational challenges.    Serve as the primary champion for business objectives and steer long-term program strategy.    Build strong partnerships with key functional team members to keep the focus on business goals.    Partner with cross-functional teammates to run workgroup alignment meetings that address tactical release issues, dependencies, team status, production issues, metrics, and achievements.    Lead program and feature dependencies across multiple teams, scrum teams, functions, divisions, and partners.    Identify potential roadblocks early and address them with urgency to keep project teams on track toward their delivery goals.    Deliver monthly program evaluations and status updates during sprint reviews, covering goal progress, risk factors, and key concerns.    Create a collaborative environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and learning.    Act as a change agent across the enterprise, promoting the SNS Product and Technology strategy and inspiring organizational transformation.      You’re Our Person If...     Must currently hold an active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance with polygraph (required).    Have 4+ years of experience managing complex technical initiatives and projects from initiation to completion in a Software as a Service (SaaS) or Platform as a Service (PaaS) product development organization.    Understand the product development and software development lifecycles, and apply Agile principles alongside traditional project management best practices.    Have experience prioritizing, structuring, and managing individual and team deliverables in alignment with strategic objectives.    Have experience leading cross-functional teams.    Communicate clearly in writing and speech, and tailor your approach to build consensus with key stakeholders.    Have experience driving results and aligning expectations across complex, matrixed, and cross-functional organizations.    Have a track record of resolving challenges in coordinating distributed and global teams.      Even Better If...     You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) Dedicated Region air-gapped environment builds.    You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and sound judgment in navigating conflict and solving complex problems.    You have experience using analysis to drive roadmap development and prioritization.    You hold a Certified Scrum Master (or equivalent Agile) certification.       This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.This position requires a USA TS/SCI with Polygraph security access level.      Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Sr Principal Technical Program Manager, CAD Engineering and AI Initiatives
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.     Our CAD Engineering organization helps enable the design of next-generation memory and semiconductor products by advancing the tools, infrastructure, and methodologies our engineering teams rely on! We work across design, technology, IT, data science, and EDA partners to improve engineering productivity and bring new automation capabilities into global design environments.     As a Senior Principal Technical Program Manager for CAD Engineering and AI Initiatives in San Jose, California, you will lead strategic programs that modernize CAD tools and design flows while accelerating the practical adoption of AI and machine learning. You will translate sophisticated technical opportunities into executable roadmaps, align global teams, and take initiatives from concept and proof of concept through production deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact!      Responsibilities:     Lead end-to-end CAD and AI programs, handling roadmaps, achievements, dependencies, resources, risks, governance, and delivery across concurrent workstreams  Drive development, integration, migration, and adoption of CAD tools, design flows, methodologies, EDA platforms, and infrastructure supporting HBM, DRAM, NAND, and emerging memory technologies  Define and implement AI/ML-enabled CAD and design automation initiatives, including design-space exploration, predictive verification, layout optimization, generative AI copilots, and automated debug  Establish program success metrics and measure productivity, cycle-time, quality, cost, and return on investment while supporting responsible AI practices for data governance, security, IP protection, and model lifecycle management  Align CAD engineering, design, process technology, IT/HPC, data science, EDA vendors, and executive partners while driving organizational change and adoption      Minimum Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field    12+ years of demonstrated ability in the semiconductor, EDA, or high-tech industry, including 6+ years in technical program or project management  Demonstrated experience leading complex, diverse engineering programs from concept through delivery in fast-paced technical environments  Solid understanding of CAD/EDA tools, semiconductor design flows, and semiconductor design and development processes  Hands-on exposure to AI/ML concepts and engineering or automation applications, with strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and technical interpersonal skills      Preferred Qualifications:     Master’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science, MBA, or PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Agile/Scrum certification, or equivalent experience    Experience with DRAM or NAND development and EDA platforms such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA, including HPC compute, license management, and flow automation  Experience delivering production AI/ML or generative AI solutions, including MLOps, data pipelines, LLM-based tooling, or AI-enabled CAD and design automation  Solid understanding of Python, C++, Tcl, or Perl, along with experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, or Power BI  Experience managing EDA vendors or strategic technology partners and driving technology adoption across global, multi-site engineering teams       The US base salary range that Micron Technology title: Senior Technical Program Manager, DGX Cloud Infrastructure Operations
description_html: NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive infrastructure operations across DGX Cloud. In this role, you will partner closely with engineering, operations, and reliability teams to improve service health, increase infrastructure availability, and strengthen execution across a large-scale AI cloud environment. This is an outstanding opportunity for a senior program leader who thrives in highly technical settings and knows how to translate complex signals into clear priorities, aligned plans, and measurable business outcomes.    What you’ll be doing    Drive complex technical programs focused on infrastructure operations, service health, operational readiness, and platform reliability.  Partner with engineering, operations, and reliability teams to improve infrastructure visibility and accelerate issue resolution.  Build and manage coordinated program plans, achievements, dependencies, risks, and success metrics across multiple teams.  Lead cross-functional operating cadences for execution tracking, issue review, customer concern management, and leadership communication.  Translate operational data, telemetry, and incident trends into prioritized actions with clear owners and measurable closure plans.  Improve the mechanisms used to track infrastructure health, operational risks, and recovery progress.  Coordinate readiness for maintenance events, infrastructure changes, and large-scale operational transitions.  Align teams around the highest-impact issues affecting infrastructure performance and service quality.  Communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to technical and leadership audiences.     What we need to see    12+ years of technical program management, infrastructure program management, or related experience in large-scale cloud or platform environments.  Proven track record leading complex cross-functional programs across engineering and operations teams.  Experience with infrastructure reliability, observability, operational readiness, or service health initiatives.  Strong ability to translate technical complexity into structured plans, decisions, and executive-ready communication.  Demonstrated success managing dependencies, risks, and blocking issues in matrixed organizations.  Technical fluency in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or large-scale platform operations.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.     Ways to stand out from the crowd    Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, or high-performance computing environments.  Experience improving service health, infrastructure availability, or operational metrics at scale.  Background partnering closely with infrastructure, reliability, or observability teams.  Strong history of creating scalable operating mechanisms that improve execution across organizations.       Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family  www.nvidiabenefits.com/      Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits . description_html: Enterprise Architect - NY          This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                     Job Description:        We are seeking a seasoned Enterprise Architect to join our team as a critical, highly technical resource focused on strategic accounts. This role will own architecture and solution design, develop compelling customer value propositions, and drive engagement across opportunities in network virtualization, hybrid cloud, Networking, compute, Storage, AI, and managed services. The successful candidate will rapidly integrate with account teams, shape technical and business approaches to meet customer needs, build and nurture relationships at all levels, and help expand the account.     Responsibilities:     Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.  Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.  Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.  Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.  Translates outcome-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.  Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.  Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.  Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.  Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.  Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.  Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.  Participates in deep-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.  Produces in-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.  Develops, configures, and right sizes an optimal workload solution, balancing cost, scope, scale, boundaries, and benefits to deliver superior value and increase the win rate.  Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.  Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.  Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up-selling, and cross-selling opportunities) within the account.  Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.  Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.  Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.  Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.  Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.  Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.      Education and Experience:     First-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.  7+ years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling  Knowledge-based as well as 1+ experienced-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.  Previous experience solution selling within the Cloud or AI space is highly preferred.  Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.  Ability to travel up to 35% of the time      Knowledge and Skills:     Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs-of-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.  Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.  Advanced ability to translate aaS and complete ecosystem, differentiated value, solutions, and workloads and ability to prioritize aaS offerings and consumption models that will achieve the customer’s outcomes and greatest return.  Advanced understanding of aaS business model variations.  Advanced ability to collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.  Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as needed to perform job requirements.  Demonstrates advanced discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point-of-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.  Advanced business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage— with an understanding of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles, including typical KPIs important to, CxOs and line-of-business (LOB) executives; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.  Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.  Advanced company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.  Advanced resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.  Hands on experience with one or more products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.  Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.  Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.  Advanced project and time management knowledge or experience with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.  Advanced knowledge of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization, understanding of the company's go-to-market strategy.  Advanced understanding of Geo application of company’s go-to-market strategy as it relates to partners; has broad knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals.  Advanced strategic planning and account planning skills, as well as being an expert at using business and technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems.        Accessibility    HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked  here .    Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
